before.name: Head, jawline and external landmarks
before.description: Slender rorqual with a V-shaped rostrum, single central ridge and tall posterior falcate dorsal fin. The selected pale right lower jaw and dark left jaw are asymmetric; chevron patterns vary between individuals. Selected external reconstructions are not measured internal anatomy. New selected external lip/jaw opening and inner oral surfaces are shown in the feeding study; internal tissue unions and physiology remain unresolved.

before.name: Horizontal flukes and caudal peduncle
before.description: Selected horizontal flukes articulate dorsoventrally with the posterior body. Planform, excursion, tissue limits and optical response are authored and unmeasured; no computed thrust or hydrodynamic validation.

before.name: Dorsal exterior and species-specific appendages
before.description: Selected fin, ridge or finless dorsal region follows this species account. Flipper proportions and visible marks are selected external comparisons, not universal diagnostics or fitted specimen dimensions.

after.name: Head, jawline and external landmarks
after.description: The supplied artist V-shaped rostrum, small lateral eye and lower-jaw outline are retained and compared with real fin-whale photos. after.name: Dorsal exterior and species-specific appendages

after.title: Fin Whale
after.author: Johann Woelper
after.sourceScope: Actual user-supplied source archive corresponds to Johann Woelper fin-whale public metadata/thumbnail/control counts and filenames. Original colour, normal, AO, curvature, roughness and metalness maps retained. The selected live-colour/material adjustment is not measured reflectance; curvature and metalness images are not active biological skin maps.
after.delivery: Bundled GLB converted from the actual user-supplied OBJ. Two Catmull-Clark levels, selected uniform scale/orientation, UV image-origin conversion and disclosed albedo derivative; three active normal/roughness/AO payloads exact to supplied PNGs. All six original maps and original OBJ retained byte-exact in the licensed source ZIP.
after.biology: Source title and original geometry compared with NOAA fin-whale anatomy, retained licensed whole photos and nine privately supplied photo references. Artist title/photo association is not independent determination or a fitted specimen.
changes: Two Catmull-Clark levels smooth the supplied cage without reusing a blue/humpback body.
Active albedo has an original-map tone derivative and dark anatomical-left mandibular field; original albedo retained in source ZIP.
Selected jaw split, attached lining,300display plates per rack and anterior pouch motion follow this same derived artist surface.
Finite fixed-station posterior stroke, distal fluke pitch, glide/turn studies; no measured speed, thrust, motor control, prey, flow, filtration or swallowing.

viewerRig.description: Supplied sculpted fin-whale body, original UV-bound detail maps and a disclosed albedo correction. Finite same-surface jaw/pouch and posterior stroke/glide studies are authored and uncalibrated; complete swimming, prey handling, flow, filtration and swallowing remain unfinished.
viewerRig.sourceStudy: No source animation supplied; all movement is authored and uncalibrated.

albedo.scope: Original licensed artist atlas with disclosed luminance/saturation remap and a selected dark anatomical-left mandibular field, compared with NOAA anatomy; not measured reflectance or a fitted individual

before.status: Reference-led anatomy, skin and finite external behavior revision; further realism and biological validation remain incomplete
remaining: Rostral and jaw cross-sections, mandibular rotation, pouch volume/strain, baleen arrangement, posterior throat closure, fin roots, scar placement and tissue optics remain unmeasured. Oral exteriors overlap; histological unions, tongue inversion, water transport and filtration are unresolved.
Full swimming trajectories, prey capture/transport, suction/flow, contact forces, filtration/swallowing and physiology are not completed or validated.
Software compatibility comparison includes normal/roughness-map lighting; final WebGL optics have not been reviewed.
